svg.title: Packed-bed reactor with axial conversion and temperature profiles
svg.desc: Isometric fixed-bed catalytic reactor with a quarter cut-away through shell, coolant jacket and bed: spherical catalyst pellets between perforated support grids, feed in at the left nozzle, product out at the right, coolant counter-current in the jacket. Below, on the reactor's own axis z, a 1-D plug-flow model (first-order exothermic reaction, Arrhenius rate, cooled wall; Da 1.4, St 6, ΔTad 170 K, γ 20, T0 = Tc = 600 K): conversion X(z) rises to 0.984; temperature T(z) peaks at a 670 K hot spot at z/L = 0.28, then the jacket cools it back.
